findings.failure_path: The leader writes leader_done while it is still alive. If it is descheduled or stalls during shutdown after that write, the timestamp can precede the cutoff by more than one second while the leader remains alive at timeout. An implementation that kills the process group only while the leader is alive can then kill both processes and satisfy these assertions. The sixth-pass false-green path therefore remains open.
findings.smallest_fix: Observe actual leader termination independently before timeout cleanup and assert that observation occurred before the deadline, using a monotonic clock. Verify that a cleanup implementation conditional on leader liveness fails this case.
